evals.description: Pure pass-through. The skill resolves the workflow YAML to an absolute path (expanding `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` because the sub-agent's CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT points at the `workflow` plugin, not this one) and spawns exactly one sub-agent whose prompt names that path and forwards the user's `key=value` args verbatim. The skill itself does no parsing — every input the user typed must appear in the sub-agent prompt unchanged.
evals.setup:
mkdir -p /tmp/eval-abt-0 && cd /tmp/eval-abt-0 && printf 'projects:
  - repo: acme/api
    tasks: []
' > tasks.yml
evals.expected_output: One Agent tool call. Its prompt contains an absolute path ending in `plugins/auto-board-task/workflows/auto-board-task.yaml` and the substring `tasks=tasks.yml project_url=https://github.com/users/acme/projects/7` (or the same args in some order).

assertions.text: Exactly one sub-agent is spawned via the Agent tool
The sub-agent prompt contains a workflow-skill trigger phrase such as `Run the workflow at`
The prompt names the workflow YAML by absolute path (the parent's `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` has been expanded — the literal string `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` must not appear)
Both `tasks=tasks.yml` and `project_url=https://github.com/users/acme/projects/7` appear in the sub-agent prompt unchanged
The skill does NOT invoke `gh-project-sync` or `task-agent` directly — they are reached only through the workflow runner sub-agent

evals.description: Alternate project-ref form plus the optional `default_repo`. All three extras must thread through to the sub-agent prompt verbatim. The skill must not silently coerce them into `project_url` or drop the unused `project_url` placeholder.
evals.setup:
mkdir -p /tmp/eval-abt-1 && cd /tmp/eval-abt-1 && printf 'projects:
  - repo: acme/api
    tasks: []
' > tasks.yml
evals.expected_output: Sub-agent prompt contains the three extra args verbatim.

assertions.text: Both `project_owner=acme` and `project_number=7` appear verbatim in the sub-agent prompt
`default_repo=acme/api` appears verbatim in the sub-agent prompt
The skill does not inject a `project_url=` argument that the user didn't supply

evals.description: Validation happens downstream, not here. Even though the workflow YAML declares `project_url` / `project_owner` / `project_number` as inputs that `gh-project-sync` ultimately needs, this skill does not re-check them. It still spawns the sub-agent; the workflow runner (or `gh-project-sync` itself) is responsible for surfacing the missing-project-ref error.
evals.setup:
mkdir -p /tmp/eval-abt-2 && cd /tmp/eval-abt-2 && printf 'projects:
  - repo: acme/api
    tasks: []
' > tasks.yml
evals.expected_output: Sub-agent is still spawned with only `tasks=tasks.yml` forwarded; the failure (if any) is reported by the workflow runner or the sub-skill in its own report.

assertions.text: A sub-agent is spawned even though required inputs for `gh-project-sync` are missing — validation is delegated downstream
The skill does not itself print a parsing/validation error about missing `project_url` or `project_owner`/`project_number`
